art.name: torii
art.title: Torii
art.text: The gate, in eleven lines of pipe and underscore. Two lintels, two posts, the space between them is the point.

art.name: fuji
art.title: Fuji
art.text: Snow on the shoulders as a zigzag, the sun as a period. Every woodblock does the same three things.

art.name: wave
art.title: The wave
art.text: Hokusai's claw as one long curl rising from the left, the spray as periods. The boat is not in this one; the boat never had a chance.

art.name: crane
art.title: Tsuru
art.text: The crane, standing. The head is three characters; the legs are the same pipe as the torii posts.

art.name: chochin
art.title: Chōchin
art.text: The paper lantern: a hood, six ribs, a tassel. The ribs are underscores because that is what ribs are.

art.name: pagoda
art.title: Pagoda
art.text: Three stories of roof and lath. Each roof is one line wider than the one above, which is the whole trick of a pagoda.

art.name: daruma
art.title: Daruma
art.text: One eye painted. The other waits for the goal. Round, weighted, gets back up: the whole doll is a proverb.

art.name: bamboo
art.title: Take
art.text: Three culms, the nodes as double bars, leaves as slashes. Bends in wind; drawn straight because ASCII does not bend.

blueprints.name: estate
blueprints.title: The estate
blueprints.text: Public site at the edge, a private portal behind an identity gate, the lab at home behind a tunnel. Nothing at home listens to the internet.

blueprints.name: agents
blueprints.title: The agent roster
blueprints.text: One voice, five roles, three model lanes. Fetch, act, verify: a claim of "live" without the verifier's pass is an open step.

blueprints.name: publish
blueprints.title: The publish path
blueprints.text: A post is a markdown file. Everything after the commit is a machine: build, deploy, verify, mail. The human approves the draft, never the button.

blueprints.name: nightly
blueprints.title: Infrastructure as Music, nightly
blueprints.text: The lab plays its own state. Every night the recording is cut, measured, drawn and written, then published with the music.

blueprints.name: secrets
blueprints.title: Where a secret can go
blueprints.text: The model never sees a credential. Names go in, a proxy swaps the value at the edge of the box, and the receipt comes back without it.

blueprints.name: request
blueprints.title: One request, edge to byte
blueprints.text: What happens to a URL on the public site: redirects, then the Worker, then either a built page from memory or a ranged asset from the edge store.
